verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can describe an app in natural language with no coding skills and Base44 builds it, as an AI-powered app builder for full-stack apps (base44-docs-31, base44-probe-1, base44-docs-17). The generated apps include a built-in database and data management, plus login pages (base44-docs-9, base44-docs-30). Hands-on community reports corroborate this: one user got a fully functional app, another built and deployed an app in two prompts, and others praise the integrated database (base44-comm-5, base44-comm-6, base44-comm-2). Missing for 10: evidence that complex apps (e.g. a full web shop) reliably come from a single description, since one user says the AI can hit walls on larger builds (base44-comm-8).
